text:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — the Launch Post dashboard shows a huge bump in 'Form started' but submissions didn't move. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
MetricsBot: Alert: conversion_rate_form drop >10% for /launch-2026 cohort (auto-detected)
Marco Li: Yep, I'm seeing the same in raw events. Looks like a lot of events with utm_source=null around 03/15 14:20 UTC.
Ava Gomez: That cohort includes webinar invite emails — are signups down too?
Jon Park: Webinar registration conversion down ~12% for that sent email cohort. Noticed more 'start' than 'complete' in the same window.
Elena Ruiz: Did we change tracking on the microsite or the form recently? I thought we had a small GTM tweak last week.
Priya Nair: We rolled a small GTM change to fire the form tracker on click instead of submit to capture early abandons. Could be noisy.
Marco Li: Running a quick query now to confirm. SQL snippet: ```
SELECT event_type, count(*)
FROM events
WHERE page = '/launch' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY event_type;
```
Marco Li: Results show ~9.8k 'form_start' vs 1.1k 'form_submit' in the spike window; normally ratio is ~3:1, this is 9:1.
Ava Gomez: Ouch. That explains why dashboard attribution looks off — many starts with no utm, so our attribution rollup is creating a new "unknown" bucket.
Jon Park: Do we want to revert GTM or patch the dashboard? If it's a known noisy signal we should avoid surfacing it in the weekly KPI.
Priya Nair: My vote is to revert the GTM tweak for now. We wanted early-abandon metrics but not at cost of KPI signal. I can roll back and re-deploy the prior tag.
Marco Li: I can add a temporary ETL filter: ignore form_start events without a session_id or with utm_source=null for the launch dashboard until we confirm.
Elena Ruiz: For the webinar funnel, can we map the email cohort by message_id instead of utm to avoid losing signal?
Ava Gomez: Yes, we'll backfill message_id mapping for that cohort. Also updating webinar messaging to call out the CTA more directly — should help completion.
MetricsBot: Note: Weekly KPI report scheduled in 2 hours. Current draft includes the noisy 'Form started' metric — consider swapping to 'form_submit' for launch channel.
Priya Nair: Action items: 1) I roll back GTM change (ETA 20m), 2) Marco adds ETL filter (ETA 1h), 3) Ava/backfill message_id mapping (ETA EOD).
Marco Li: I'll also run a quick dashboard pre/post snapshot so DashOps sees what changed.
Jon Park: If anyone needs me to pause the weekly report, ping me. Otherwise I'll patch the KPI email to surface submit-only numbers for launch channel.
Ava Gomez: Thanks — will follow up with a short note for the comms doc once backfill logic is in. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Thanks all — keeping this out of the KPI noise is priority.
Elena Ruiz: Great catch.
MetricsBot: Incident annotation: suspected tracking config change caused KPI noise; flagged for next week's postmortem.
